what: Planned G fixtures reference $STUB_PR_HEAD_OID even though that default only exists inside the generated gh stub
scenario_or_breakage: Because the harness runs under set -u and no parent-scope STUB_PR_HEAD_OID is defined for G, env GH_VIEW_SECOND_HEAD_OID="$STUB_PR_HEAD_OID" aborts before merge-pr.sh runs
suggested_fix: Use literal matching values in G fixtures, for example STUB_PR_HEAD_OID=aaaa1111 and GH_VIEW_SECOND_HEAD_OID=aaaa1111, or use GH_VIEW_SECOND_HEAD_OID="${STUB_PR_HEAD_OID:-aaaa1111}" without relying on the stub-local default
